invariants.ontology_coherence: every relation touches declared concepts; every concept participates

concepts.definition: The cyclical information pathway connecting execution outcomes to generative modification, enabling continuous improvement through observation and integration
The meta-level artifact that produces workflow generation systems through a generative grammar, existing through participation in feedback cycles
The past-directed design level that captures explicit knowledge, patterns, and learned procedures for persistence across generations
The present-directed design level that responds to context in real-time through sensing, adaptation protocols, and exception handling
The future-directed design level that processes feedback into patterns and proposes improvements to generative structures
The process of identifying regularities, anomalies, and trends within captured feedback data to transform raw observations into structured information
The process of proposing explanations for extracted patterns and suggesting specific modifications that could improve outcomes
The process of incorporating verified hypotheses into the constructor's generative structures, making learning permanent
The formal system embedded in the constructor defining what workflow generation systems and workflows are possible to produce
